content.body: I'm pretty sure that when we did CSS imports we decided we would solve this before adding declarative markup.
Also from a CSP and security perspective it would be very weird if it suddenly started fetching more things.

I don't see how there is a CSP/security issue in doing this later. Also I don't know what we decided in the past, I wasn't there and it's a bit vague. I think declaratively importing modules and module support in @import are both important but I don't see why there is a clear order of which should come first.

As in <link rel=stylesheet> already fetches things, eg images and fonts and the stylesheet itself. The fact that type=module only fetches one style max and might fetch more in the future doesn't change that essence
